columns.caption: First rows of the file — choose what each column is

preset.PNEZD: PNEZD — No., Northing(Y), Easting(X), Elev., Description
preset.PENZD: PENZD — No., Easting(X), Northing(Y), Elev., Description

unit.label: File units
unit.declared: The drawing declares its units — nothing to choose.

suggested.greek-grid: We suggested “{unit}”: the coordinates fall inside the Greek grid (EGSA '87). Change it if the file says otherwise.
suggested.extent: We suggested “{unit}” from the size of the survey. Change it if the file says otherwise.

unit.needed: We could not tell the file's units — choose them so the terrain can be computed.

file.typesHint: CSV, TXT, XYZ, Excel (.xlsx) or DXF with points and elevations

refusals.xls-legacy: This is an old Excel file (.xls), which cannot be read safely. Open it in Excel and save it as “Excel Workbook (.xlsx)” or as CSV.
refusals.dxf-binary: This DXF is saved in binary form. Save it again from your CAD program as a text (ASCII) DXF.
refusals.unsupported: This file format is not a survey we can read. Upload CSV, TXT, XYZ, Excel (.xlsx) or DXF.
refusals.unreadable: The file could not be read — it may be damaged or locked by another program. Close it there and try again.
refusals.empty: The file has no points. Check that you chose the survey file and not another drawing or sheet.

points.summary: {points, plural, one {# point} other {# points}} · {withElevation} with elevation
points.noPosition: Choose which columns are X and Y — without them there are no points.
points.skipped: {count, plural, one {# row that is not a point was skipped} other {# rows that are not points were skipped}}: {rows}
points.coincident: {count, plural, one {# position was measured twice with the same elevation — one was kept} other {# positions were measured twice with the same elevation — one was kept}}
points.conflicting: {count, plural, one {# position has two different elevations — marked on the map; check it with the surveyor} other {# positions have two different elevations — marked on the map; check them with the surveyor}}

buyer.heading: What buyers will see
buyer.intro: The same figures that will be published, from the same computation. Your points and your file are never published — only the map and the statistics.

declaration.surveyorNameHint: As it will appear on the listing as the source of the survey.
declaration.surveyedOnHint: The day of the field measurement, not of drafting or sending.
declaration.rights: I have the right to publish this survey (I made it or I have its author's permission).
declaration.rightsHint: The declaration is kept with the survey. Only the map and the statistics are published, with the surveyor and the date as their source.

listing.published: The terrain is published — the listing already shows it.
listing.withdrawn: The survey was saved, but the listing is not published right now; it will show once the listing is published again.
listing.failed: The survey was saved, but the listing has not been updated yet. It will update automatically — no need to send it again.
listing.absent: The survey was saved, but no listing was found to update.
listing.unknown: The survey was saved. We do not know yet whether the listing was updated — check it in a moment.

refusals.TERRAIN_SOURCE_REQUIRED: No survey was sent — choose the file again and retry
refusals.TERRAIN_TYPE_UNSUPPORTED: The survey was not sent in the format the server accepts — reload the page and try again
refusals.TERRAIN_SOURCE_EMPTY: The survey arrived empty — check that you chose the right file
refusals.TERRAIN_SOURCE_TOO_LARGE: The survey is larger than {maxMegabytes} MB — thin out the points and try again
refusals.TERRAIN_SOURCE_MALFORMED: The survey data cannot be read or exceeds the limits (up to {maxPoints} points) — check the file and its coordinate columns
refusals.TERRAIN_DECLARATION_INVALID: The declaration is incomplete — fill in the surveyor and the survey date, and confirm you have the right to publish
refusals.TERRAIN_SURVEY_DATE_IN_FUTURE: The survey date is in the future — correct it and try again
refusals.TERRAIN_NOT_LAND: Terrain relief is published only for plots and land parcels
refusals.TERRAIN_INSUFFICIENT_SURFACE: The points do not form a ground surface — at least three points with elevation are needed, not all on one line
refusals.TERRAIN_EMPTY_AFTER_CLIP: No part of the terrain falls inside the plot boundary — check that boundary and points share the same coordinate system
refusals.TERRAIN_TOO_DENSE: The relief comes out above {maxTriangles} triangles — thin out the points and try again
refusals.TERRAIN_PUBLICATION_NOT_CAPABLE: You do not have permission to publish material to listings
refusals.TERRAIN_NO_DOSSIER: This listing has no property dossier to keep the survey in
refusals.TERRAIN_UPLOAD_FAILED: Saving the survey failed on the server — try again
refusals.network: We do not know whether the upload arrived — check your connection and press again; it will not be published twice.
refusals.rejected: The server refused the survey for a reason we do not recognise — try again or contact us.

publish.unavailable: To publish a survey, the listing needs a property dossier in your account, where the file is kept.

current.heading: Published now
current.none: The listing has no terrain relief yet. Upload the plot's survey — buyers will see the elevation difference, slopes and a contour map.
current.replaceHint: A new survey replaces the published one.
